build_bbox_decoder: build a BBoxDecoder module that generates bounding box predictions for table cells using attention and LSTM
create_cell_attention: create a CellAttention network that computes attention-weighted encodings from encoder, decoder, and language outputs
run_bbox_decoder_inference: run BBoxDecoder inference to predict cell classes and bounding boxes from encoded image features and tag hidden states
init_bbox_decoder_hidden: initialize hidden state for BBoxDecoder from mean of encoder output and specified batch size
configure_cell_attention_dims: configure CellAttention with encoder, tag decoder, language, and attention dimensions for multi-source attention
